description: This file provides the implementation of a utility function to create an object container in the ANSC framework. It defines the function 'AnscCreateObjectContainer' which delegates creation to 'AnscOcoCreate'. It includes licensing information, module details, and references to external functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateObjectContainer(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new object container object, delegating the creation to 'AnscOcoCreate'.
